## TL;DR

Pipeline cards now use the same `ActivityIndicator` as Board cards, with a shared motion coordinator that pauses animations when cards or views are not visible. Settings gain an activity-animation On/Off toggle and a compact layout. Shot capture skips server polls for client-only fixture task ids (`pipe-*`, `#9999`) so handoff UI verify no longer 404s on landable.

## Work and rationale

Implemented visibility-aware activity animation in `ActivityIndicator` and `activity-motion.ts`, wired `PipelineCard`, kept Board/Pipeline mounted with `v-show` for scroll state, and added `activityAnimationEnabled` plus compact Settings styling. Review fixes covered occlusion hit-testing, board/pipeline coexistence, and ui-smoke board targeting. Extended `isSeededShotFixtureTask` via `shotPreviewSkipsServerBackedTaskRecord` so preview fixtures do not call `/landable` for synthetic ids while `?shotState=` is active.

## Approaches tried

Central motion coordinator with one `IntersectionObserver` and `visibilitychange` listener; cap counting only visible indicators. Pipeline handoff failures traced to hidden Board `TaskCard` landable polls on `pipe-*` ids seeded by `board:pipeline`.

## Challenges and blockers

Handoff verify 404s on fixture landable; remote check intermittently hung on thinkpad or failed a timing-sensitive `release-agent` test on mini (passed locally on retry). Format gate failed until `bun run fmt` was run on the final tree.

## Key learnings

Shot fixture guards must cover every synthetic task id pattern (`pipe-*`), not only `#9999`, whenever both views stay mounted. Re-run `repoos check` after fmt WIP checkpoints before handoff.
